title: eReader as agent monitor?
author: CPTNJCKSPRRW
selftext:
I was working on a project today and trying out Orchestrator Inc. I had some long-running tests that I wanted to keep an eye on in case the agents needed approvals or had questions for me.

My PS5 is plugged into the same monitor, so I figured I'd play some games or watch something while the agents did their thing. Normally I'd use my phone to monitor them, but it was nearly dead, and I'm not a huge fan of leaving my phone screen on for extended periods anyway.

Then I realized my Boox eReader runs Android and has an E Ink display, so why not try installing the app on it?

It actually works surprisingly well for keeping an eye on the dashboard and interacting with the orchestrator. The only thing I wish I could do is scale up the UI and text a bit, but it's not a dealbreaker considering I'm mostly using it to glance at the progress.

This was more of a quick experiment, but now I'm tempted to build a dedicated E Ink agent monitor using a Raspberry Pi I have lying around and 3D print a case for it. I'm working on my own agent interface anyway, so it would make for a pretty cool test device.

Curious if anyone else has tried something similar?
